## The Material Basis of Computation

Welcome to **Logic 101: Symbolic Logic & Automated Reasoning**. This course bridges the material basis of computation with abstract formal logic. You will learn how abstract reasoning is physically realized in digital circuits and hardware, covering syntax, semantics, and the foundational elements of automated verification.

The course employs a historical materialist framework. The development of formal logic is understood not as the descent of platonic forms from an abstract ether, but as the intellectual artifact of specific social formations, technological epochs, and shifting labor processes.
